description: Devin is an AI software engineering agent with a v3 REST API and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Service user API keys (cog_ prefix) sent in the Authorization header; personal access tokens work the same way. Legacy v1/v2 keys are deprecated.
gate_detail: Keys are created in Settings > Devin API by provisioning a service user with an RBAC role. Sources do not say which plan or role is needed. Enterprise PATs are disabled by default and may need admin approval.
api_scope: v3 organization endpoints for sessions, attachments, knowledge notes and playbooks; enterprise endpoints for cross-org management, analytics, audit logs and billing.
mcp_notes: Official Devin MCP server over Streamable HTTP; authenticated with a PAT or service user key.
blocker_detail: Credentials come from admin-managed service users with RBAC roles; plan requirements are not stated, and enterprise PATs need a policy or approval.

evidence.quote: Copy the API key — the key starts with cog_ and is shown only once, right after provisioning
Use the key in the Authorization header of every API request
Assign a role that controls which endpoints the service user can access.
Approval required Members submit a PAT request; an enterprise admin must approve it before the token can be created

uncertainties: Sources do not state whether a free plan or a paid plan is needed to provision service users.
Webhooks and sandbox are not mentioned in the provided excerpts.
REST is inferred from curl examples against api.devin.ai/v3 endpoints.
